title: Background Queue Backlog in Email Service Due to Stuck Jobs
description: Email service background job queue backed up due to a malformed email template causing jobs to fail and retry indefinitely. Queue depth grew to 500k messages, processing latency exceeded 4 hours.
initial_symptoms: Transactional emails not sending (welcome, receipts, notifications)
Email service workers at 100% CPU but throughput near zero

evidence_catalog.summary: Email queue depth grew from 10k to 500k over 2 hours
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT queue_depth FROM queue_metrics WHERE service='email-service' AND queue='emails'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate queue depth metrics

evidence_catalog.summary: Worker logs show 'Template rendering failed: undefined variable user.referral_code' repeating for same message ID
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM worker_logs WHERE service='email-service' AND message LIKE '%undefined variable%'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate worker error logs

evidence_catalog.summary: Deployment deploy-794 updated email templates including new referral email
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create deployment with template changes

evidence_catalog.summary: Commit added referral_code variable to welcome template but not all user objects have it
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create commit with template diff

evidence_catalog.summary: Job retry rate increased from 0.1% to 95% as same failed messages retry indefinitely
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT job_retries / job_attempts FROM job_metrics WHERE service='email-service'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate job retry metrics

changes.summary: Deployed new email templates with referral_code variable

causal_chain.from_description: Deployment added referral_code to template without handling missing data
causal_chain.to_description: Template rendering fails for users without referral_code, job retries indefinitely

causal_chain.from_description: Failed jobs re-queued with no backoff limit, clogging queue
causal_chain.to_description: Queue depth 500k, throughput near zero, dead letter queue growing

causal_chain.from_description: Transactional emails not delivered for 6+ hours
causal_chain.to_description: Users not receiving welcome emails, receipts, notifications

contributing_factors: No max retry limit on queue

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Email service CPU high (workers busy retrying)

required_checks.description: Inspect queue for repeated message IDs
required_checks.expected_outcome: Same message IDs retrying with template error
Template references user.referral_code not always present

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Fix template to handle missing referral_code; add max retry limit; move poison messages to dead letter
test_plan: Test template with user objects missing referral_code
Add max retries=3 to queue config
Drain dead letter queue after fix
